risks: model ranking does not hold across windows
series is close to noise; fitted weights would overfit
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~13% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. The spectrum is close to white noise, so most of the variation is irregular and hard to predict. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (1 points, ~1% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.107), which favours a robust combination.

The series has very high trend and seasonality but unstable ranking; a robust trimmed mean may outperform weighted schemes by discarding extreme models.
try a robust median combination given unstable ranking and strong seasonality.
The series has unstable ranking and many correlated errors; a per‑horizon best‑model weighting could exploit horizon‑specific strengths.
test a weighted combination with inverse_error to see if simple error‑based weighting beats the softmax variant given unstable ranking.
The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a robust DBA may outperform simple weighted combos.
Outlier‑heavy series with unstable ranking suggests a forward‑selection weight to pick complementary models.
Use a focused subset (pool4) with inverse_error weighting to see if a smaller, more stable pool improves performance over full‑pool weighted.
Try a per‑horizon weighted scheme on the stable pool4 using softmax_neg_error to capture complementary strengths while reducing overfitting on this noisy, seasonal series.
Try a per‑horizon weighted scheme using the top‑k‑per‑horizon handle (w8) on the full pool to exploit horizon‑varying strengths.

The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a robust weighted scheme on the full pool may still improve over the current best. I will test the weighted combination using the previously computed weight handle w1 (likely inverse_error or similar) on pool_full to see if it can beat the current leader.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w2' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9936. Series context: trend strength 0.9994 and seasonal strength 0.9999; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.107); 6 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.644.
